pictures.author: Diego Delso
pictures.observations: Maneckji/eastern tower in its own Commons category: low roofless ocher ring with uneven broken top on a rocky hill, narrow stepped/supported approach. Lower auxiliary buildings and the complete hill are separate context, not a composite tower mesh.

pictures.author: Petr Adam Dohnalek
pictures.observations: Maneckji category interior shows low irregular rubble enclosure, dusty/gravel court, broad shallow central pit with broken stony lip, scattered rubble and sparse standing fragments. No roof or furnished burial reconstruction.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific standing eastern/southeastern Maneckji dakhma at Yazd: irregular mapped ring with low damaged roofless masonry and sparse ocher plaster remnants, genuinely open narrow arched passage, bounded supported approach steps, gritty open court, shallow irregular recessed central pit/broken lip and sparse rubble. Four reused shared rubble/raw sandstone/stucco/gravel graphs. No intact historical tall tower, roof, bodies/bones, copied label/photo atlas, lower precinct buildings, the other dakhma, complete hill or broad terrain slab.
